kind: simulated statistics [S]; no physics was run

model.linear_predictor: a_k + u_t + w_kt + v_ts on the 13 short tasks
model.w_arm_task: N(0, sig_int/sqrt(2)) per arm; pairwise difference SD = sig_int
model.v_instance: N(0, sig_inst), shared across arms at a (task, seed)
model.calibration: per replicate, expected successes per panel (integrating v by 40-node Gauss-Hermite) equal the scenario rate x 19

rules.futility: approach mean <= 3.0/19 over 3 seeds OR discordant wins over recovery <= losses
rules.gate: one-sided exact task-stratified CMH vs uniform and vs recovery, Holm at alpha=0.025, both rejected, AND approach mean >= 5.0/19
rules.p_confirm: P(not futile AND gate passes at total S); Phase 0.4 assumed to pass
rules.mcnemar_variant: same gate with pooled one-sided exact McNemar (comparison only)

recommendation.criterion: smallest total S in the grid with P(confirm) >= 0.80 when approach's true rate is 6/19 (uniform 2/19, recovery 4/19), base variance config
